title: DaylightPaint Command
description: Replace the daylight overlay: delete forsk:kind=analysis objects, then add one welded vertex-coloured mesh on A-ANALYSE that fills each room to its inner wall faces. Display mode 'Forsk Analysis': mesh wires off, unlit vertex colours. The layer is off in every layout detail and does not print. Sky-vis proxy, not lux.

z.description: Mesh height in mm, usually the floor plus 50.

vertices.description: Mesh vertices [x, y] in mm, each once: cell centres inside rooms and points on the room outlines.

colors.description: One Forsk sky ramp colour per vertex (display only; scores are Planwire's).

faces.description: Triangles and quads of vertex indices.
